item.title: He Said His Non-Verbal Stepson Did It
item.description:
Kendra Farler was 15 when she was fatally shot with a shotgun at her father’s Dayton home. Her father initially blamed his nonverbal, autistic stepson, but investigators found inconsistencies. Farler later admitted he had fired the gun, despite Kendra reportedly asking him to stop pointing it at her. He eventually pleaded guilty and was sentenced to 23–28.5 years.
How could someone try to make the most vulnerable person in the house take the blame?
